suddenly started wobbling……"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower

N-No, that's not it. It must be Rice's bad 
luck causing this...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Even though Big Brother worked so hard for 
Rice's sake...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower

Even though Big Sister worked so hard for 
Rice's sake...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice is the one who's causing trouble, so 
I'm so sorry...!
It ended in a disappointing result...
